instruction: A deep-sea anglerfish rendered as leaded stained glass, its bulbous body divided into curved panes of midnight blue, teal, and violet held by dark pewter cames. A hooked lure arm arches over the head ending in a bulb of amber glass that glows like a lamp, while the jagged teeth are shards of frosted white glass. Light passing through casts colored patches across the fish's fanned pectoral fins.
